intro: I turn ideas into production-ready products: web, mobile, and AI-powered. Happiest building with teams that share a big vision.
aboutLead: I love ==building with people==. Big visions, sharp minds, and products that actually ship.

aboutSections.label: Background
aboutSections.text: Self-taught builder. Moved to ==Addis Ababa== a couple of years ago and have been shipping from here ever since. Curious by default, always learning something new.

aboutSections.label: How I work
aboutSections.text: I like ==teams and shared ownership==. I can cover the whole stack when needed, but I grow fastest next to people chasing the same vision. Clear, fast, and fun to work with.

aboutSections.label: What I love
aboutSections.text: Making things people actually use. Lately that means ==AI tools==, automation, and a bit of DSA practice on the side. If it removes busywork or sparks a cool idea, I'm in.

aboutSections.label: Community
aboutSections.text: As a ==Cursor Ambassador== I run meetups and hackathons. I love communities because that's where good people and big ideas meet.
